name: YJ Mosaic 3x3 Cube Set of 64 (8x8 3.5cm Cubes)
description: The YJ Mosaic 3x3 Cube Set (64 x 3.5cm Cubes) unlocks a whole new level of creativity for cube mosaic artists and collectors. This unique set features 64 miniature 3x3 cubes, each measuring just 3.5cm, perfectly arranged in an 8x8 grid. Specially designed for building stunning mosaic displays, it empowers artists to express intricate patterns, portraits, and designs using twisty puzzles.
